(FAQ)

Questions

Where do you shoot?

On site at your business across New York City and North Jersey. Travel outside that area is quoted separately.

Do I own the photos and videos?

Yes. You get full commercial use of everything we deliver for your business.

How fast do we get the files?

Photos and short videos are usually delivered within 5 to 7 business days. Brand films take longer and are scheduled up front.

Can you run our social accounts?

Yes. Managed Social covers planning, writing, posting and replying to comments every month.
